name: Gorm
description: Gorm was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Meerian sector. Located on the Galactic Frontier by 4000 BBY, it was the homeworld of the venomous reptiles known as gorm-worms, which were exported across the galaxy. Around 3643 BBY, an individual visited the ancient Gorm Academy in order to study its secrets.
